meta.name: analyzing-cloud-storage-access-patterns
meta.description: Detect abnormal access patterns in AWS S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage by analyzing CloudTrail Data Events, GCS audit logs, and Azure Storage Analytics. Identifies after-hours bulk downloads, access from new IP addresses, unusual API calls (GetObject spikes), and potential data exfiltration using statistical baselines and time-series anomaly detection.

copy.tagline: 检测云存储异常访问与数据泄露
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果你需要监控云存储访问模式并发现潜在安全威胁。
copy.tagline_en: Detect abnormal cloud storage access and data exfiltration
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to monitor cloud storage access patterns and identify potential security threats.

howto.what: 分析 AWS S3、GCS 和 Azure Blob Storage 的访问日志，检测异常模式，如非工作时间大量下载、新 IP 访问、异常 API 调用等。
howto.when: 当需要调查云存储安全事件、构建检测规则或进行威胁狩猎时触发。

say.text: 分析过去24小时S3存储桶的异常访问模式。
检查是否有来自新IP地址的GetObject调用。
检测非工作时间的大批量下载行为。

howto.what_en: Analyzes access logs from AWS S3, GCS, and Azure Blob Storage to detect abnormal patterns such as after-hours bulk downloads, new IP access, and unusual API calls.
howto.when_en: Triggered when investigating cloud storage security incidents, building detection rules, or performing threat hunting.

say_en.text: Analyze abnormal access patterns for the S3 bucket in the last 24 hours.
Check for GetObject calls from new IP addresses.
Detect bulk downloads outside business hours.
